editor.title: Edit project

sections.detailsDescription: Experts read this before they write a proposal. Don't include passwords, API keys or personal data.

fields.descriptionHint: What should the AI do, for whom, and how will you know it works? At least 100 characters.
fields.businessProblemHint: What happens now, and what does it cost you?

fields.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once the project is published.
